Chapter 209: Chapter 10: Rejection (Subscribe Please)

The moment the outer region of the Door to the Myriad Realms lit up—

Lin Yuan knew.

“Is it possible to travel now?”

Lin Yuan’s mind went to the depths of his consciousness, gazing at that majestic and grand Door to the Myriad Realms.

“Just now…..”

Lin Yuan slightly furrowed his brows.

...

He was at a critical period, transitioning from the Fifth Rank to the Sixth Rank.

The Soul Compatibility had already reached eighty-five percent, very close to Perfection.

Increasing the Soul Compatibility required Lin Yuan to devote all his energy to Enlightenment and the perfecting of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

If he were to travel now, with his consciousness descending into other worlds, it would be equivalent to halting the process of soul evolution.

After the trip, when Lin Yuan stepped into the Sixth Rank in a foreign world and returned to the Main World,

he would still need to spend time and energy to complete the last part of his Soul Compatibility.

What Lin Yuan truly worried about wasn’t the above.

Rather, abruptly ceasing the soul evolution could lead to some undesirable outcomes.

Such as Soul Compatibility not progressing but regressing? Or the speed of compatibility suddenly slowing down, etc.

In the long years of human civilization in the universe, some Fifth Rank Evolvers, while matching their souls with their Evolution Paths, experienced various interruptions due to accidents.

When they restarted the evolution and compatibility, they found that the speed and efficiency of Soul Compatibility were significantly affected.

“Forget it.”

“I will travel after completing the soul transformation into the Sixth Rank.”

Lin Yuan’s expression revealed a brief contemplation, and finally, he made up his mind.

Delaying the travel wouldn’t cause any loss to Lin Yuan, the Door to the Myriad Realms would still continue to accumulate energy.

Just like a ten-liter cup constantly dripping water into it, the moment the water in the cup reached one liter, Lin Yuan could travel.

The instant he traveled, it would consume that one liter of water.

But if he chose not to travel, that one liter of water wouldn’t disappear; it would still remain in the cup, not affecting the subsequent increase of water in the cup.

Theoretically, Lin Yuan could wait for years and travel continuously.

Or try other functions of the Door to the Myriad Realms, like what uses would there be after lighting up the core region?

…

Outside Canglan Star.

A spaceship slowly stopped, undergoing Star Platform security inspection.

“Boss, we’ve arrived at Canglan Star, we’ve reached our destination.”

Inside the ship, a green-haired young man excitedly said, “It’s my first time leaving my home planet, Canglan Star must have many fun places, right?”

“Fun?”

A green-haired middle-aged man opened his eyes and sighed.

“You’ll see how painful it is to be stationed on such a Middle-grade Life Planet for a long time.”

The green-haired middle-aged man glanced at the green-haired young man.

“Ah? Painful?”

The green-haired young man blinked in surprise.

“Could it be something good?”

The green-haired middle-aged man scoffed, “The various entertainment activities, welfare benefits, and the supply of cosmic energy on a Middle-grade Life Planet, can they compare to those on a higher-grade Life Planet?”

“This time, if it wasn’t for the young lady’s orders to establish a trade outpost on Canglan Star, I wouldn’t have wanted to come here.”

The green-haired middle-aged man sighed again.

“Yes, it’s said that a genius Evolver from Canglan Star, Lin Yuan, rejected Heiyu Ao’s recruitment, causing the whole Canglan Star to be targeted and suppressed.”

“Fortunately, another genius Evolver from Canglan Star, Fang Qing, joined the Red Kun Lineage. Fang Qing and Lin Yuan have a deep relationship, so Fang Qing, for Lin Yuan’s sake, sought the help of the young lady and other Red Kun Lineage Evolvers, trying to rebuild the trade channels…”

The green-haired youth obviously did his homework before coming.

It’s his first time leaving his homeland planet, naturally, he must prepare thoroughly.

“Fang Qing is really considerate.”

The green-haired young man said somewhat enviously.

Who wouldn’t hope to have such a friend who would stand up for them when they are being oppressed and bullied?

“Indeed.”

“Fang Qing is loyal, but that Lin Yuan, he simply doesn’t recognize favors.”

The green-haired middle-aged man shook his head, “With Mr. Ao’s status personally recruiting, showing respect and humility, yet Lin Yuan even dared to refuse, recklessly implicating the entire Canglan Star.”

“Such a person is extremely selfish in nature, without Fang Qing’s help, his future would definitely be miserable.”

The green-haired middle-aged man slowly said.

His view was also the view of most people, especially those assigned to establish the trade station, who harbored some resentment towards Lin Yuan.

“That is true,” the green-haired youth nodded slightly.

He had been taught by his family from a young age to sacrifice everything for the family when necessary. If he was in Lin Yuan’s position, he would never make such self-centered decisions.

“Actually, there’s no need to wait for later.”

“As Fang Qing just joined the Red Kun Lineage, remembering his friendship with Lin Yuan, but as time passes, with the help of the Red Kun Lineage, Fang Qing will soar, stepping into Fifth Rank, stepping into Sixth Rank.”

“But Lin Yuan, even though he is a once-in-decades-evolution genius from Canglan Star, will most likely stop at the Fifth Rank.”

“As the gap in strength between the two grows larger, can their friendship still be maintained? How could a dragon ever be friends with an ant?”

The green-haired middle-aged man shared his thoughts.

“In hundreds, thousands of years, Fang Qing’s fondness for Lin Yuan will naturally fade.”

The green-haired middle-aged man said calmly.

“Indeed.”

“Peers of the same strength level can’t become friends…” the green-haired young man nodded in agreement.

…

Central Continent Manor, Main Building.

“I must achieve Perfection in Soul Compatibility transformation as soon as possible…”

Since the Door to the Myriad Realms could enable travel at any time, Lin Yuan thought about hastening the speed of his Soul Compatibility.

“Perhaps I could spar with other strong Evolvers?”
